At a White House press conference on 20 November 2026, Donald Trump talked about the APEC host city, Shenzhen: "What a job President Xi has done. It's clean. It's immaculate… It was a fishing village." He compared it with US cities ("some of them are so embarrassing"), said of Xi Jinping, "He runs 1.4 billion people", and said Xi told him: "We thought you were dead. You've beaten all of us now." His last word on it: "I think we have more potential than they do." Shenzhen became China's first special economic zone in 1980. Today almost 18 million people live there. Is he right?
